---
title: "A Plain Markdown Post"
date: "2016-12-30"
---

This is a post written in plain Markdown (`*.md`) instead of R Markdown (`*.qmd` with R chunks). The major differences are:

1. You cannot run any R code in a plain Markdown document, whereas in a Quarto document, you can embed R code chunks (```` ```{r} ````);
2. A plain Markdown post is rendered directly through [Pandoc](https://pandoc.org), while a Quarto document with code is first executed by [**knitr**](https://yihui.org/knitr/) or [Jupyter](https://jupyter.org), then rendered by Pandoc.

You can write task lists in Markdown:

- [x] Write an R package.
- [ ] Write a book.
- [ ] ...
- [ ] Profit!

Quarto uses Pandoc natively, so LaTeX math works in all documents — no backtick workarounds needed. Inline math: $S_n = \sum_{i=1}^n X_i$. Display math:

$$
\int_0^\infty e^{-x^2} dx = \frac{\sqrt{\pi}}{2}
$$

When creating a new post, you can use the Quarto CLI:

```bash
quarto create post "Post Title"
```
